identification: Cast iron two-ring umbrella/walking-stick stand in Victorian Coalbrookdale style: branch/twig stem with loop handle, two lugs/heads at the ring junction, scallop-shell drip tray and two dolphin feet. Black paint, some rust in tray. Probably late Victorian or a later reproduction; cannot tell.

entries.note: Genuine Coalbrookdale 'Fern' pattern walkingstick stand, 19th century; hammer, AUD, no FX. Database record only (not page opened). Marked genuine piece, so it is the ceiling if this lot proved to be real, which looks unlikely.
